note: Hand-curated wage/workforce provisos from Part IB of each enacted appropriations act (term-matched candidate sets in provisos/{year}/). Budget provisos are one-year rules enacted inside the annual budget bill; votes attach to the whole appropriations bill (or a named amendment), never to one proviso. FY 2020-21 had no enacted Part IB (COVID continuing resolution) — stated explicitly per the workflow's none-found rule.

cycles.note: No enacted Part IB this cycle: H5201 died in committee during COVID; the state ran on continuing resolution H3411 plus CARES acts.
